description: Kryptic sealed-box P-256 interop known-answer test. Every runtime (C#, Go, WebCrypto) must satisfy: (1) Open(recipientPrivateKey, sealed) yields plaintext; (2) sealing plaintext to recipientPublicKey using the fixed ephemeral key reproduces `sealed` byte-for-byte. See docs/PHASE-2-TASKS.md for the wire format.
kdf: HKDF-SHA256, salt empty, info = "kryptic-sealed-box-v1" || ephemeralPublicKey || recipientPublicKey; expand to 44 bytes = 32-byte AES key || 12-byte nonce (nonce is derived, not random)
